title: The Globe and Mail: eXoZymes Sets Date for 2026 Shareholders Meeting
summary: eXoZymes announced that it scheduled its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders for November 13, 2026, setting a formal timeline for its upcoming governance and voting activities. The company established September 15, 2026 as the record date to determine eligible shareholders and indicated plans to distribute proxy materials around September 28, 2026, clarifying key deadlines for investor participation.
body_markdown: eXoZymes announced that it scheduled its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders for November 13, 2026, setting a formal timeline for its upcoming governance and voting activities. The company established September 15, 2026 as the record date to determine eligible shareholders and indicated plans to distribute proxy materials around September 28, 2026, clarifying key deadlines for investor participation.
